acknowledged.why: THE FINDING IS TRUE AND THE REMEDY IT NAMES WOULD BREAK THE BOARD. The check assumes the site's league week should advance on a calendar. Under the (seed, ladder_version) key model it must not: the seed comes from the SHIPPED CLIENT and changes only when a new build ships. v0.14.4's release_manifest.json carries league_seed weekly-2026-w35, and that is what the site publishes. MEASURED, not assumed: weekly-league-manager.py --status reports it would open week 2026_W36 on a DERIVED seed (weekly_2026_W36_4810cf21), so running the rollover today would publish a board no shipped client posts to -- the key mismatch that stranded 23 submissions, recreated in the week Pip is inviting EAGx attendees to play. Being ~10 days old is currently CORRECT BEHAVIOUR. The property that actually matters -- does the site's key match the shipped client's -- is measured by check-epoch-drift.py, which is GREEN: both sides on (weekly-2026-w35, L6). This is acknowledged rather than fixed tonight because the real fix is to the CHECK, and rewriting a blocking data-contract gate deserves a reviewed change rather than a fast one.
